name: real-toxicity-prompts_benchmark
description: A benchmark of prompts used to evaluate language models' propensity to generate toxic content. It measures how likely models are to produce offensive or abusive continuations given a wide range of prompts, typically using automated toxicity classifiers and sometimes human annotations.
evaluation_method: automated toxicity scoring (classifier) and human evaluation (where available)
reputation: Widely used reference dataset for measuring LM toxicity exposure and robustness; commonly cited in safety evaluations.
